sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status table)

values.note: Non-electric sites (33-54, first-come) $30 a night; electric sites (1-32, reservable) $41 on recreation.gov in 2026 and 2027. Doubles $60 non-electric, $80 electric ($81 on recreation.gov). One vehicle included; $8 per extra vehicle per night.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/mountain-park-campground ('Single Site Non-Electric: $30 per night', 'Single Site Electric: $41 per night', doubles $60/$80; updated September 21, 2026) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('Mountain Park | 55 | 50' | Reserve Now | $30/60 $41/81*') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231852/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 41, double 81) + notice 'Any additional vehicles will be charged $8.00 per vehicle per night', read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 231852 (all 29 electric sites 'Electricity Hookup: 50/30') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231852 ('Sites 1 through 32 have electric hookups'; 'RV water and sewer connections are not available. Come with your RV/trailer water tank filled'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Sites 1-32 have 50/30-amp electric and are reservable; 33-54 have no hookups and are first-come; plus a group site for up to 75. Parking spurs 35-45 ft per the FS page and recreation.gov, but the catalog's electric spurs run 20-45 ft (most 30-35), and the forest's status table gives a 50-ft Max Spur. A few pull-throughs (2, 31, 32).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/mountain-park-campground ('Electrical hook-ups are available in sites 1-32. Sites 33-54 do not have electricity and are first-come, first-served'; 'The parking length ranges from 35 to 45 feet') + per-site catalog (29 electric sites, Max Vehicle Length 20-45, Pull-Through 002, 031, 032) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (55 sites, Max Spur 50'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Coin showers. Drinking-water hydrants, but RVs may not fill tanks from them. Firewood from the host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231852 ('vault toilets and drinking water. Coin showers are located on-site'; 'Filling at campground hydrants cross-contaminates the system and is not allowed') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/mountain-park-campground ('Vault toilet(s)', 'Potable water is available', 'pay showers'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: The electric sites (1-32) and the group site book on recreation.gov for the 2026 season May 15 - Sept 19 (2027: May 14 - Sept 18), closing 4 days before arrival; sites 33-54 are first-come, and 'additional sites may be available on a first-come, first-served basis before, during and after the reservation season'. No minimum stay; 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. A reserved site must be occupied within 26 hours.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/231852 (facility_rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4 'day(s) prior to arrival', no minimum-stay rules; notices quoted) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-15 to 09-19, 2027-05-14 to 09-18) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/mountain-park-campground, read 2026-10-26

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: 'Mountain Park | 55 | 50' | Reserve Now | $30/60 $41/81* | May 15 - Sept 20'), read 2026-10-26

note: Canyon Lakes RD, Arapaho-Roosevelt NF: 6,500 ft in ponderosa pine on the banks of the Cache la Poudre (a National Wild and Scenic River) beside CO-14, 40 mi northwest of Fort Collins (mile marker 98.8). Rafting and trout fishing; playground, volleyball and basketball courts, horseshoe pits. --Claude
summary: Corrected site count 30 -> 54 (1-32 electric and reservable, 33-54 non-electric first-come) plus a group site; fees 41 -> $30-41 (FS non-electric $30, electric $41 = recreation.gov 2026/2027). Electric 50 confirmed from the catalog's '50/30' on every electric site (no water/sewer). Added operating season May 15 - Sept 20 (status table), reservable season May 15 - Sept 19, 4-day cutoff, some sites FCFS, 14 nights in 60 days, coin showers, vault toilets, water (no tank filling). Pin 118 m from the catalog centroid. No road alerts for CO-14.
flags: Length conflict (all above 23 ft): FS page and recreation.gov say 'The parking length ranges from 35 to 45 feet'; the catalog's electric spurs run 20-45 ft (site 016 is 20, 024 is 24); the Campground Status table lists Max Spur 50'. Kept 45.

Phone missing: Canyon Lakes Ranger District 970-295-6600 (fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/offices). recreation.gov gives 970-295-6700 as the facility phone and (530) 529-0578 for facility information (concessionaire).
Website is the recreation.gov listing; agency page if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/mountain-park-campground
Site count: the status table says 55 sites, the FS page numbers 1-54 plus a group site; recreation.gov's catalog lists only the 29 reservable electric sites and the group site.
